delete.description:
Close the bank session (and consent, where the bank supports it). The accounts and
their history stay.

get.description:
Hidden accounts are left out unless `include_hidden` (ADR-0007, "Retiring an
account").

patch.description:
Only an account's owners can change it. Hiding it, or making it a shared pot, is for
the whole household.

delete.description:
Delete an account with its transactions and everything decided about them, its
balances and its transfer pairs. An account with transactions needs `confirm=true`.

A pair's side on an account that stays is kept as a transfer, so spending and income
don't change. If the bank still offers the account, a re-link brings it back: hiding is
the lasting way to retire it.

get.description:
Newest first. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. A group's
`category_id` includes its categories; `uncategorized` leaves out transfers; `source` is
who set the category (`ai`: suggestions to review).

patch.description:
Set what a transaction is. Values set here win over rules and defaults; `null` hands
the field back to them.

post.description:
Keep AI-suggested categories: each becomes the user's own, as if picked by hand, so no
rule or merchant default replaces it. Transactions without one are left alone.
Pair two transactions as a transfer by hand.

delete.description: Undo a pair. Matching won't link these two again.

get.description: Groups and their categories, archived ones included (flagged).

post.description: A new group (no parent) or a category in a group.

patch.description:
Rename, reorder, move a category to another group, or archive (and unarchive).
Archiving a group archives its categories; archived categories get no new transactions.

delete.description: Only unused categories can be deleted; archive the others.

post.description:
A merchant no bank name has made yet, for a rule or a transaction to point at. Names
that compare the same as an existing one's are refused.

patch.description:
Rename, or set the default category for all its transactions (past and future), unless
a rule or a choice made by hand says otherwise.

post.description: Fold one counterparty into another: its bank names, transactions and rules follow.
A new rule, last in order. Categorization re-runs.

put.description: The new order of all the household's rules, first to last.

post.description: How many visible transactions these conditions match, with the most recent examples.
Pair transfers and categorize everything again.

get.description:
Spending per expense group and category, per month: booked transactions that aren't
transfers, net of refunds. The months end with `until`'s (default: this month).
Income and spending per month, from the same sums as the spending chart.

Net worth per day, from the first day every included account has data for (or
`date_from`, if later) to today, plus each included account's balance today.

Each budget for `month`'s month (default: this one): its limit, what last month carried
in, what's available, spent and remaining, counting the accounts of `view`.

put.description: Cap all spending, uncategorized included, from `from_month` on. Works like `setBudget`.

delete.description: Remove the overall budget, its past months included.

put.description:
Budget the category from `from_month` on: earlier months keep their amounts, later
changes are replaced. Rollover and overspend apply to every month.

delete.description: Remove the budget, its past months included.

get.description: Active first, then by next expected date.

Expected dates of active, confirmed series in the next `days` days, soonest first. A
payment that's due but not late yet shows on its expected date. Euro amounts use today's
rate.

AccountDeleteBlocked.title: AccountDeleteBlocked
AccountDeleteBlocked.description: Why a delete needs `confirm=true`: what would go with the account.

ApplyToCounterparty.title: ApplyToCounterparty
ApplyToCounterparty.description: Offered after a category is set by hand: make it the counterparty's default too.

OverallBudgetOut.title: OverallBudgetOut
OverallBudgetOut.description: The cap on all spending, uncategorized included: cash flow's figure for the month.

Overspend.title: Overspend
Overspend.description: What overspending a budget does to the next month (ADR-0007, "Budgets").

RecurringUpdate.title: RecurringUpdate
RecurringUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change. An empty `name` goes back to the detected one.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: What the user made of a detected series. Only confirmed ones count (ADR-0007).

RuleIn.title: RuleIn
RuleIn.description: The format of conditions and actions is described in categorize/rules.py.

Source.title: Source
Source.description:
Who decided something in the user layer. Precedence (ADR-0007): manual > rule >
counterparty (a merchant's default category) > ai.

SuggestionApproval.title: SuggestionApproval
SuggestionApproval.description: Transactions whose AI-suggested category the user keeps.

TransactionKind.title: TransactionKind
TransactionKind.description:
What a transaction is. Derived from its category's kind, else its sign, unless it's a
transfer or overridden.

TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate
TransactionUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. `null` hands a field back to the automatic layer
(category, counterparty, kind) or clears it (note).
